Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkEnabled: Dark climate at night and in fog
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkEnabled_too: Darkens, desaturates and tints the world at night and in the fog.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkIntensity_t: 0 disables the effect, 1 is default, 2 is double.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogDailyChance_: Every day at midnight the game rolls whether that day will have fog. It rolls in at any hour, announced by distant sirens; the fog starts rising right away and, 30 seconds later, the monsters wake up. Outside the event there is no fog at all.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEscalation: Fog: tension that grows with the days
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEscalation_t: On: the daily chance rises in a straight line to the maximum chance on the curve day. Red fog does not follow the curve.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMaxDailyChan: Daily chance at the end of the tension curve.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEscalationDa: Save day when the daily chance reaches the maximum.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogSecondChance: Fog: second fog same day chance (%%)
On a day with fog, chance of another after the minimum gap. It starts before midnight.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMinGapHours_: In-game hours without fog before the next one can start.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMaxDaysWitho: After this many consecutive days without fog, the next day is guaranteed. 0 means fog every day.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMinHours_too: Shortest white fog, in in-game hours.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMaxHours_too: Longest white fog, in in-game hours. Each white fog lasts a random value between the minimum and the maximum.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogEnabled_t: Sometimes the fog comes red: harsh attack sirens full of static warn, the fog turns red (the light too, with the dark climate on) and every zombie inside it is a monster, split evenly among the enabled types (Clicker, Runner, Faceless, Mourner); a disabled type's share stays normal. Echoes stay Echoes.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogChance_to: Percentage of fogs that come red. Rolled once per fog, at the siren: saving and loading does not change it. No fog comes red during the grace days.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogGraceDays: For this many days at the start of the save no fog comes red. 0 turns the grace period off.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogMinHours_: Shortest red fog, in in-game hours.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogMaxHours_: Longest red fog, in in-game hours. Each red fog lasts a random value between the minimum and the maximum.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.BlackFogEnabled: Rarely the fog comes black: an out-of-tune siren warns, the world goes dark as a moonless night even at noon and every zombie becomes a Cinder, which freezes in the beam of a flashlight, car headlights or a lit lamp. No other monster and no Echo while it lasts.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.BlackFogChance_: Percentage of fogs that come black. Rolled once per fog, at the siren: saving and loading does not change it. No fog comes black during the grace days. A black fog is never red.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.BlackFogGraceDa: For this many days at the start of the save no fog comes black. 0 turns the grace period off.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.BlackFogMinHour: Shortest black fog, in in-game hours.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.BlackFogMaxHour: Longest black fog, in in-game hours. Each black fog lasts a random value between the minimum and the maximum.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogCalmHours_to: When fog ends, common zombies move slower and sense less for this many in-game hours. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogBaseHeight_t: Height of the ground fog sea. Low (~0.45) keeps the camera clear with heavy mist at floor level. High (~1.2) restores the old full-volume soup.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogPocketAggres: Traveling pockets of absurd fog. 0 off; 1 = rare and brutal (default); 2 = more often/intense (Nightmare). Outside them, base height applies.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogZombieVision: In white and red fog, common zombies only see this far. Beyond it they only find you by noise: running, shooting, a car. Fog monsters keep their own ways. 0 turns it off (normal sight).
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogWander_toolt: In white and red fog, every so often groups of 1 to 3 idle zombies near you start walking around the area, never toward you: you can run into them at any time, without a horde.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.AlmaEnabled_too: In white fog, waves of black skeletal souls rise in the street (mostly crawling), slowly seek the player, and fade after seconds to a minute. They never enter buildings and do not replace fog monsters.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoEnabled_tool: Bodies near players release Echoes at night, once per body, but only bodies that died before dusk: whoever dies at night waits for the next one. Burn or bury the dead. An Echo's bite infects like any zombie's.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoMaxPerPlayer: How many Echoes can be alive near each player at the same time.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoRadius_toolt: Distance from the player within which a body can release an Echo.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightFaster_too: At night every zombie moves faster (see the multiplier).
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSharperSen: At night zombies see and hear farther, and a lit flashlight outdoors draws zombies from afar.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightHunt_toolt: At night, every so often, zombies near each player go to them even without seeing them.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSpeedMult_: Game speed comes in steps (shambler, fast shambler, sprinter): 1.0 keeps it, 1.5 raises one step, 2.5 raises two.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSenseMult_: Sight and hearing come in steps: 1.0 keeps them, 1.5 raises one, 2.5 raises two. Also multiplies the flashlight range (20 tiles x value).
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.HuntIntervalMin: How often, at night, zombies are called to each player.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.HuntRadius_tool: Distance from the player within which zombies hear the hunt call.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EstaladorEnable: In fog, day or night, some zombies become Clickers: blind, guided only by sound, clicking every so often. Crouched and silent, you can walk right past them.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorEnabled: In fog, day or night, some zombies become Runners: they sprint and, when they see a player, scream and call the zombies around.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EstaladorChance: Percentage of zombies that become Clickers in each fog. All fog monsters share one roll: if the chances add up to more than 100, the ones after Clickers get less.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorChance_: Percentage of zombies that become Runners in each fog. Same roll as Clickers, Faceless and Mourners: above 100 in total, the ones after Runners get less.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorScreamR: Distance within which zombies hear the Runner scream and go to it.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.SemRostoEnabled: In fog some zombies become Faceless: look at one (or shine a light on it) and it vanishes, only to reappear closer, out of your sight. The radio hisses in your head when one is near.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.SemRostoChance_: Percentage of zombies that become Faceless in each fog. Same roll as Clickers and Runners, after them: above 100 in total, Faceless (and Mourners, who come after) get only what is left.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraEnabl: In fog some zombies become Mourners: they stand still, sobbing quietly. Get close, point a flashlight at one or make a loud noise nearby and it lets out a scream that calls zombies from far away, then runs after whoever woke it. One scream per fog.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraChanc: Percentage of zombies that become Mourners in each fog. Same roll as the other monsters, after all of them: above 100 in total, Mourners get only what is left.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraTrigg: A player this close wakes the Mourner, even crouched. A flashlight pointed at it or a loud noise (a gunshot) wakes it from up to 10 tiles.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraScrea: How far zombies hear the Mourner scream and come to it.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogAmbience_too: In fog a low drone and distant metallic noises replace the ambience, and nearby TVs, radios and cars hiss and speak. Only on your game.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogOverlays: Fog: blood and decay on floors and walls
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogOverlays_too: In fog, the world around you turns into the Otherworld: blood running down the walls, grime and cracks on floors and walls, burnt floors indoors, weeds and vines outdoors, heavier in red fog. Only you see them; they vanish when the fog lifts and nothing stays on the map or in the save. Each player sets the amount in Options > Mods.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogVignette_too: In fog the screen edges darken and blur. It steps aside while you forage.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogVignetteInte: 0 disables the effect, 1 is default, 2 is double.
